glossEn: direct toward itself or oneself by means of some psychological power or physical attributes
note: direct toward itself or oneself by means of some psychological or romantic interest。线索：attract attention / be attracted to。
be attractive to。系动词用法：sb/sth + attract + adj（The plan attracts me.）。

glossEn: exert a force on (a body) causing it to approach or prevent it from moving away
note: exert a force on (a body) causing it to approach or prevent it。技术义：opposite poles attract。现有中文无对应，属新增。与 s1 的判别句：She attracted a large crowd. / Opposite magnetic poles attract each other.
